تحتسبون (form VIII)
# تَحْتَسِبُونَ (taḥtasibūna) /taħ.ta.si.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
# تُحْتَسَبُونَ (tuḥtasabūna) /tuħ.ta.sa.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَسَبَ (iḥtasaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
